protocol.primary_endpoint: Original development complete-group binding accuracy at 34000 online observations.
protocol.secondary_endpoints: Exact four-byte greedy answers, original/expanded train monitors, earlier-reader loss change from 10000 observations, live-loop cost and graph decoding.
protocol.comparison: All arms train from scratch on identical selected source bytes and observation/replay schedules. The associative and H512 selective arms share initial common weights. H588 selective has 104 more parameters than associative, controlling approximately for parameter count. Generated byte contents and recurrence differ. Seeds are paired, not shared trained ancestors.
protocol.timing: Separate first-10000 and subsequent-24000 live-loop segments, including replay, speech, logging and checkpoint writes; excludes process setup and assessment. No concurrent GPU study processes.
protocol.limits: Three-seed early screen at 24000 binding observations, not a full exposure or hyperparameter search. The assay uses two candidate answers and four-byte box/bag generation, not general language.

cpu_oracle.interpretation: Numerical sanity check of one fixed group per model, not an independent quality benchmark.
